app.bootFailedHelpHtml: If you opened index.html straight from disk, serve the folder instead, for example with python3 -m http.server, then open http://localhost:8000.

region.callNow: Call for help straight away with
hurt.title: Tap where it hurts
hurt.summary: Pick the area on the figure, or from the list below. Each area lists what lies there, the common causes of pain and when to get help.
hurt.note3dHtml: Drag to turn the body, or press B to see it from behind. The labels at the sides show which is its right and left.
hurt.noteBackHtml: You’re looking at the figure from behind, so its right side is on your right, like your own body. Switch to Front (in settings, or B) for the chest, belly and face.
hurt.noteFrontHtml: The figure faces you, so its right side is on your left. {mirror} Switch to Back (in settings, or B) for the back and buttocks.
hurt.mirrorOn: Mirror is on: the figure now matches your own body like a mirror.
hurt.mirrorOffHtml: Turn on Mirror in settings to match it to your own body.
home.eyebrow: A connected map of the body
home.lede: The human body as one system. Tap any bone, joint, ligament, tendon, muscle, organ, nerve, blood vessel or lymph node to see what it is, what it connects to and what commonly goes wrong.
home.howTo1Html: Tap a structure. It turns red, everything it connects to turns teal, and the joints between them pulse.
home.howTo2Html: Layers (top left): switch on Ligaments, Muscles, Organs, Vessels, Lymphatics or Nerves. The layer you touched last is in focus, and the others stay faintly visible behind it.
home.howTo3Html: Search / for any bone, muscle, organ, nerve, blood vessel, body area or condition (try “tennis elbow”), or open Browse for the full list.
home.howTo4Html: Where does it hurt? Tap a body area to see what lies there, the likely causes, and when to get help.
home.howTo5Html: Settings (the cog, top right) turn the figure around (Front / Back, or B), switch between simple and realistic drawings (D), set the biological sex, which adds the reproductive organs and the conditions that only affect one sex (S), choose the language, and turn on Mirror to match the figure to your own body.
home.howTo6Html: Zoom with the scroll wheel, a pinch or the + / − buttons, and drag to pan. Small bones are easier to tap when zoomed in.
home.position: The figure stands in the anatomical position (palms forward). From the front the body’s right is on your left; from the back it is on your right.
